usage: This is the standard, everyday way to ask someone how they are across the Levant. It is appropriate for friends, family, and casual acquaintances. The suffix must change to match the gender and number of the people you are speaking to.

variants.label: to a woman
variants.note: Use this when addressing a single female.

variants.label: to a group
variants.note: Use this when addressing two or more people.

variants.label: more formal (to a man)
variants.note: Use this with older individuals or in professional settings.

variants.label: casual alternative (to a man)
variants.note: A very common casual alternative or follow-up question.

examples.english: Hello Ahmad, how are you today?
How are you Sara? Long time no see.
How are you guys? What are you doing?
